name: realistic
description: Randomized, compounded degradation pipeline intended to approximate the range of ways a real-world photo becomes low quality: optical/sensor blur, resizing, sensor/compression noise, JPEG re-encoding, and occasional repeated resave. Strength of each stage is randomized per-sample so the model sees a distribution of degradations rather than a single fixed operator, which is what should let it generalize beyond synthetic pairs.

second_pass.description: Simulates an image being resized/re-shared/re-compressed more than once.

order_randomization.description: Randomly swap order of noise and jpeg stages per-sample so the model doesn't learn a single fixed artifact ordering.
